Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You spread your arms, and the roots answer as if the whole orchard had stirred in its sleep.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Reason
Target / range / shape
Up to three visible grounded creatures within 5 squares.
Duration
Instant. Applied conditions follow their normal duration and decay.
Equipment / acquisition
No item needed unless named above.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Magic

Branches and roots answer together. Make one roll using the net Boons or Banes least favorable to you among the targets; apply the result to all of them. You choose targets; allies need not be included.

Weak
Pull each 1 square toward you.
Standard
Pull each 2 squares and apply Slowed 1.
Strong
Pull each 3 squares, apply Slowed 1 and knock each prone.
